enchantments.tooltip: Wisdom +6: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Devotion +72: Passive: +72 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Radiance +72: Passive: +72 Equipment bonus to Light and Alignment Spell Power.
Alchemist's Lore: Reduces the cost of Empower, Empower Healing, and Maximize by 2 SP. Spells cost 10%/20%/30% less when you are below 50%/25%/10% hp.
